set_session_vars: set session context variables for platform, chat_id, thread_id, user_id, and session_key in an asyncio task
clear_session_vars: clear all session context variables to empty strings and prevent os.environ fallback
get_session_env: get a session environment variable by name with contextvar-first and os.environ fallback resolution
test_set_clear_session_vars: test set_session_vars and clear_session_vars round-trip with contextvars isolation across asyncio tasks
refactor_get_session_env: refactor get_session_env to replace os.getenv calls with contextvar-aware session lookups
